name: Safe decoder diagnostics identify the failed decode without leaking host data

input.source_text: module M { public fun run() -> Object { try { JSON.decode("[1,2") } catch v, c { [v, c.decoder, c.offset, c.expected] } } } M.run()

applicability.reason: Supported. C036 requires a safe decoding diagnostic to identify the decoder, the offset when available and the violated limit or expected Contract. The raised value carried the error symbol alone; the decoder now records those three fields and ExceptionContext exposes them. C066 forbids fabricating one, so a context raised by anything other than a decode answers nil, and a later unrelated raise does not inherit the last decode's record. Only these three fields exist, so no Host path, pointer or address can leak.
